_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

struck_year.basis: the year the trial court struck the transcript

filed_day.basis: day of the month the mandamus was filed

argued_day.basis: day of the month of the argument

months_struck_to_argued.basis: calendar months from the strike's month to the argument's month, month granularity because c8 gives no day

filed_step.basis: the filing's position on the month stair, in risers from the strike month

days_filed_to_argued.basis: days from the mandamus filing to the argument

minutes_per_side.basis: minutes of argument for each side

amicus_minutes.basis: the deposition reporters' association's minutes as amicus

records_count.basis: the deposition's two records named in the claims, its video recording and its written transcript
